changelog:
【v2.75.0】中文语音换新：内置高清语音包
新增 中文释义改用内置 22.05kHz 神经语音，离线秒开，音质不再受网络影响
新增 语音包随安装包内置，首次启动自动解压一次，之后永久可用，断网也能正常朗读
优化 听读中文统一念核心释义，与整库连播口径一致，同一个词不再出现两种念法
devNotes: v2.75.0: built-in HD Chinese voice pack. 6337 unique zhText entries pre-synthesized offline with Piper zh_CN-huayan VITS (22.05kHz), shipped inside APK as assets/zhvoice.zip, unpacked to filesDir/zhvoice on first launch (versioned stamp file). Playback chain is now hdpack -> online Baidu -> system TTS for both album continuous mode (playAlbumZh/appendZhAudio/ensureZhAudio) and webview single-word mode (NativeVoice.localZh + NativePlayer.playFile). Root cause of the metallic timbre: Baidu gettts is 16kHz with zero energy above 8kHz and its per-voice parameter returns identical bytes; Edge readaloud websocket now returns 403 for every Sec-MS-GEC/version combination. Changelog format is now 'label text' lines and CI injects the newest entry into the official site automatically (scripts/site-changelog.js).
